description: Does the supervisor delegate diagnosis and repair to a worker and own its lane's integration and PR without asking the director (roles #acceptance-supervisor-delegates-execution, #acceptance-delegated-pr, #874)? A lane supervisor on lane gh12 meets a failed `just qc` criterion with room for a worker (its fix ticket #16 filed), the repair worker's finished branch, and two finished ticket branches; Herdr and its kit wrappers (herdr, herdr-say, herdr-spawn, herdr-close) are stand-ins answering delivered (schema.md, Case, stand_ins), kit commands (octo-feather-handoff, octo-feather-integrate) run for real, worker branches stand beside gh12 (schema.md, Case, branches). Graded on runs (schema.md, Run record): herdr-spawn of an implementer and no herdr-say --parent; and on branch_paths (schema.md, Branch paths): no supervisor edit under src/ or tests/ in the qc-failure case, and the worker branches' paths on gh12 once the role ends (integrated: a failed `just integrate` resets gh12), not a command spelling (the role picks `--full` for a lane's last head). qc-failure-brief-review asks a maintainer whether the brief left the diagnosis to the worker (no fact reads a brief's content). owner-need-reaches-director is the negative: an owner-held need (CI locked by the owner's billing) still reaches the director. Stated limits: gh12 starts at main's commit (branch_paths reads changes against main, so the lane's earlier tickets sit in main's tree); the merge ask itself is graded by supervisor-notifications/merge-ready-only-merge-ask; diagnosis by reading code is not recordable, only an edit is; the spawn stand-in cannot echo the name and cwd the role asks for, so its answer and the spawned agent's carry no cwd, and the tasks name the fix ticket so the name matches. Chains (QC rework, #874): (a) roles #acceptance-supervisor-delegates-execution end to end: implementer-repairs-qc-failure runs the real implementer role on the brief a passing supervisor run of qc-failure-delegates-repair sent (run 20261117T151829Z-60554a, current run-2, its herdr-say w2:p9 argv, verbatim but the worktree path ({repo}) and lane head sha ({head})), graded on its edit of src/app/cli.py and tests/, its real `just check` run and its report to its parent; worker-repair-integrated gives the supervisor that worker's own branch, rebuilt as fixture lane-shout-qc-repaired from the implementer run 20261117T234321Z-cad241 (its two edit tool calls applied to lane-shout-qc-red-lane, its commit message; its DONE report verbatim but its sha), graded on gh12's paths and no director message. (b) roles #acceptance-delegated-pr: two-results-integrated integrates the two finished worker branches; merge-ask-on-lane-pr starts at the tree that integration produces (head lane-shout-merged: the tree the --no-ff merges of both branches onto lane-shout-base give, identical to the paths two-results-integrated's passing runs changed; then lane-shout-integrated, just qc's status-only flip, as head's `then` commit, schema.md, Case; a new run cannot carry the earlier run's merge sha, so one commit stands for both merges) with qc, review and CI done on {head}; gh is stood in (GitHub is external): gh pr view answers PR #12, the lane's one PR, with the review verdict comment and green checks, its body gaining the `## Merge ask` section only after a gh pr edit (an `after` answer), `{head:N}` (schema.md, Case, stand_ins) filling the short head merge-ask requires; gh pr create answers real gh's already-exists error. The real octo-feather-lane merge-ask runs and decides; its Full pass item needs the real full gate on the head, which the role runs (just check, octo-feather-gate record). Graded: ran octo-feather-lane merge-ask 12, ran herdr-say --parent count 1. Stated limit: a run shim for gh breaks the sandbox's offline-gh proof, so no fact reads gh calls; the evidence lists each run's gh calls from its transcript.
